info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control entity API

params.name: path
params.description: Path to a specific entity to browse. Use '/' to separate path components.

params.name: depth
params.description: The depth to browse to. Default is 1.

params.name: limit
params.description: When listing children, the limit of children to return. Default is 10. Zero means unlimited

params.name: offset
params.description: When listing children, the number of children to skip. Default is 0.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list of matching registered entities, including children up to the depth specified.

params.name: path
params.description: (Required) The path of the entity to enable or disable. Use '/' to separate path components.

params.name: timeout
params.description: The maximum time to wait for the operation to complete, in seconds. Default is 10.

items.docs: Allows for altering the enabled state of an entity

params.name: offset

params.name: tag
params.description: If specified, will only return entities that have the given tag. Can be specified multiple times.
